description: Earn more meme credits after you publish. Post a meme's share_url (memeoki.com/m/...) somewhere people can see it on the open web (Reddit, X, Bluesky, Mastodon, Tumblr, a blog or forum), then send the post's link here. Memeoki opens the page logged out, confirms your meme is there, and adds credits (checked again later; deleted posts lose them). Private chats don't count as posts, but every real person who opens a share_url earns credit on its own. Needs an API key (connect with /mcp?key=...).
